m. (-वान्)
Fire, or the deity AGNI.
E.
जुह्व a sacrificial vessel, and मतुप् possessing; being the medium of (burnt) offerings; also जुहुवत्.

A tree.
3 A hard hearted man.

f. (-हूः)
A wooden vessel, of the shape of a semicircle or crescent, used at sacrifices.
E.
हु to sacrifice, Uṇādi affix क्विप्, the root reiterated, and the final made long; also remaining short जुहु. f. (-हुः.)

m. (-णः)
1 The moon.
2 Fire or its deity.
3 An officiating priest.
E.
हूर्च्छ to be crooked, to abandon, &c. Uṇādi affix आनच्; the root is reiterated, and the final छ rejected.

mfn. (-ह्वन्-ह्वती-ह्वत्)
Sacrifice, offering oblations.
E.
हु to sacrifice, शतृ aff.
